projectMetadata.name: OBE Course Outcome Attainment System
projectMetadata.description: A comprehensive React application for tracking and visualizing Course Outcome (CO) and Program Outcome (PO) attainment in Outcome-Based Education (OBE) systems. Automates the entire process from student data upload to comprehensive reporting.
projectMetadata.author: Capstone Project Team

structure.config: Configuration files for database and environment

models.User.js: MongoDB User schema with registration and login

utils.auth.js: JWT token generation and verification utilities

uploadFlow: ComprehensiveExcelUpload.jsx - Main Excel/CSV file upload with parsing
workflow: CourseInfo.jsx - Course details entry (Code, Title, Department, Year, Semester, Section)
COPOMapping.jsx - Interactive 12x12 matrix for CO-PO mapping
AssessmentConfig.jsx - Configure assessment types (CTs, Mid, Final, Assignments, Attendance, Performance)
ComprehensiveMarksEntry.jsx - Tabbed interface for marks entry by assessment type
KPIConfig.jsx - Set KPI values (Target Pass Marks, KPI for COs, KPI for POs)
ComprehensiveReports.jsx - Display all reports and visualizations
reportVisualization: Results.jsx - Comprehensive report visualization with charts and tables

utilities.excelParser.js: Parse and extract data from Excel files

core: Upload student data from Excel (.xlsx, .xls) or CSV files
Extract Student ID and Name from uploaded files
Configure multiple assessment types with CO allocation
Advanced data visualization (bar, radar, pie, line charts)
dataVisualization: Bar charts for CO/PO attainment with dual metrics
Pie charts for individual student CO performance
reporting: Overview: Class-level CO and PO attainment
Individual Student: Detailed performance with visualizations
dataPersistence: Browser localStorage for immediate data access

steps.name: Upload Students
steps.description: Upload Excel/CSV file with Student ID and Name columns
steps.output: students array with ID and Name

steps.name: Course Information
steps.description: Enter course details (Code, Title, Department, Academic Year, Semester, Section)

steps.name: CO-PO Mapping
steps.description: Map 12 Course Outcomes to 12 Program Outcomes using interactive matrix

steps.name: Assessment Configuration
steps.description: Configure assessment types and their max marks with CO allocation
steps.output: assessments array with config for each type

steps.name: Marks Entry
steps.description: Enter student marks for each assessment type in tabbed interface
steps.output: marksData object with all student marks

steps.name: KPI Configuration
steps.description: Set Target Pass Marks (default: 40%), KPI for COs (default: 50%), KPI for POs (default: 50%)

steps.name: Reports
steps.description: View comprehensive reports with multiple visualization types

coAttainment.formula: CO Score = Sum of ((Student Mark / Max Mark) × (Assessment Max / Total CO Max)) × 100
coAttainment.description: For each assessment mapped to a CO: Calculate student's percentage (Student Mark / Assessment Max Marks), Calculate weight (Assessment Max Marks / Total Max Marks for that CO), Multiply percentage × weight, Sum all assessments and multiply by 100

poAttainment.formula: PO Score = Weighted Average of related CO scores
poAttainment.description: Weight = Total marks allocated to each CO

classLevelMetrics.passMarksPercentage: % Above Pass Marks = (Count of students > Pass Marks / Total students) × 100
classLevelMetrics.kpiPercentage: % Above KPI = (Count of students > KPI / Total students) × 100

assessment.type: string (CT, MidTerm, Final, Assignment, Attendance, Performance)
assessment.coAllocations: object mapping CO indices to marks

prerequisites: MongoDB instance (local or cloud-based like MongoDB Atlas)
installation: Create .env file in root and server directories with required environment variables
Start development: npm run dev (runs both client and server concurrently)
buildAndDeploy: Build for production: npm run build
Deploy to GitHub Pages: npm run deploy

server: JWT_SECRET: Secret key for JWT token generation

importantNotes: Data persists in browser localStorage automatically
Firebase integration is optional (can be configured in src/config/firebase.js)
Calculations are based on Excel formulas and match Excel behavior exactly
All charts are interactive and support downloading as images
Authentication is JWT-based with secure token storage
The system is fully responsive and works on desktop and tablets
Sidebar provides main navigation between workflow steps
